ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels represent approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity black pixels localized to the narrow perimeter and focal mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region across the central interior of both lobes. Continuous low-intensity black border along trailing and leading edges. Left lobe displays a cluster of approximately 6-8 small, discrete low-intensity circular blobs in the lateral-superior quadrant. Right lobe displays approximately 3-5 similar discrete low-intensity blobs in the lateral-superior quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge, with pixel-amplitude peaks most pronounced toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory fitted from the median notch extending to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast clusters of brownish-yellow raised pixels at both distal fluke tips. Multiple small, circular dark pixel clusters distributed across the white ventral surface corresponding to previous attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense colonization of acorn barnacles (brown/yellow textured clusters) located on the outer-most lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
